answer: Every claim climbs the velvet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
